name: Dark Editorial Minimal
description: High-fashion, luxury architectural minimalism. Pure black canvas with stark white display typography, fine gray hairline dividers, warm burnt orange accents, and dramatic editorial portraits.
typography: Semi-condensed geometric display paired with neutral grotesque body and tabular mono utility font.
geometry: Square-edged containers with pill-shaped interactive buttons (999px radius).
motion: Staggered letter entrances, silky WebGL displacement, minimal smooth cursor tracking.

name: Swiss International Precision
description: Grid-dominant layout rooted in 1950s modernist typography. Objective clarity, stark black and white, strict column rules, bold numerical markers.
typography: Helvetica, Neue Haas Grotesk, or Akzidenz-Grotesk.
geometry: Strict rectangular grid, zero border radius.
motion: Snap transitions, zero bounce, linear or quick ease-out.

name: Modern Bento Grid
description: Asymmetric multi-cell dashboard layout grouping metrics, interactive tools, and visualizations into modular rounded cards.
typography: Inter, Geist, or SF Pro Display.
geometry: 16px to 24px border radius with 1px border highlights.

name: Neo-Brutalism
description: High-contrast visual rebellion featuring bold black outlines (2-3px), drop shadows without blur, saturated primary fills, and quirky badges.
typography: Heavy slab serif or bold grotesque sans.
geometry: Hard-edged or slight 4px radius with 4px black solid shadow.
motion: Click down-shift (translate 2px 2px) to simulate mechanical pressing.
